findings.description: The cycle-detection guard (`seen` set) was removed from the `__cause__` chain traversal. If the chain contains a cycle, the `while exc is not None` loop never terminates.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception chain where A.__cause__ is B and B.__cause__ is A, with neither cause matching `exception_cause_types`. The loop walks `exc.__cause__` forever, so the retry predicate hangs at 100% CPU instead of returning False.
